title: Neglected Risks: The Disturbing Reality of Children’s Images in Datasets and the Urgent Call for Accountability

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative analysis of False Positive and False Negative classifications in the Open Images V7 subset, revealing systemic annotation biases such as adult women being frequently and disproportionately mislabeled as 'girls' (identifying sexist undertones in the annotation framework).

Manual review of classification errors and double annotations in the Open Images V7 dataset, identifying systemic inconsistencies in how annotators assigned age-related labels (e.g., assigning conflicting labels like 'Boy' and 'Man' to the same individual, or struggling to consistently classify teenagers versus adults).
